normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Predmetlarni rangi, shakli, o‘lchami, joylashuvi va boshqa belgilariga ko‘ra ajrata olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi predmetlarni rangi, shakli, o‘lchami, joylashuvi va boshqa belgilariga ko‘ra ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: Qizil doira, ko‘k kvadrat va sariq uchburchakdan shakli doira bo‘lgan predmetni ko‘rsating.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Predmetlarni umumiy belgisi bo‘yicha guruhlay olishi va guruhlarni taqqoslay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi predmetlarni umumiy belgisi bo‘yicha guruhlay olishi va guruhlarni taqqoslay olishi.
normatives.example: 5 ta olma va 3 ta nok bor. Qaysi biri ko‘p va nechta ko‘p?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 1 dan 10 gacha sonlarni taniy olishi, sanay olishi, yozishi va taqqoslay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 1 dan 10 gacha sonlarni taniy olishi, sanay olishi, yozishi va taqqoslay olishi.
normatives.example: 7 va 4 sonlarini taqqoslang: 7>4 yoki 7<4?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 0 soni, natural sonlar, juft va toq sonlarni farqlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 0 soni, natural sonlar, juft va toq sonlarni farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: 2, 5, 8, 9 sonlaridan juft sonlarni ajrating.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 21 dan 100 gacha sonlarni o‘qiy olishi, yozishi, o‘nlik va birlikka ajratishi hamda…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 21 dan 100 gacha sonlarni o‘qiy olishi, yozishi, o‘nlik va birlikka ajratishi hamda taqqoslay olishi.
normatives.example: 47 sonida nechta o‘nlik va nechta birlik bor? 47 va 52 ni taqqoslang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 10 ichida qo‘shish va ayirish amallarini tez va to‘g‘ri bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 10 ichida qo‘shish va ayirish amallarini tez va to‘g‘ri bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 6+3 va 9−4 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 20 ichida qo‘shish va ayirishni bajara olishi, 10 ni to‘ldirish usulidan foydalana olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 20 ichida qo‘shish va ayirishni bajara olishi, 10 ni to‘ldirish usulidan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: 8+7 va 15−6 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 100 ichida sodda qo‘shish va ayirish amallarini bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 100 ichida sodda qo‘shish va ayirish amallarini bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 34+25 va 68−32 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Qo‘shish va ayirish komponentlarini ajrata olishi, noma’lum qo‘shiluvchi, kamayuvchi yoki…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qo‘shish va ayirish komponentlarini ajrata olishi, noma’lum qo‘shiluvchi, kamayuvchi yoki ayriluvchini topa olishi.
normatives.example: □+6=14 va 17−□=9 tengliklarda □ ni toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Qo‘shish va ayirish orasidagi bog‘lanishni tushunishi, teskari amal orqali javobni…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qo‘shish va ayirish orasidagi bog‘lanishni tushunishi, teskari amal orqali javobni tekshira olishi.
normatives.example: 8+5=13 bo‘lsa, shu misolga mos ikkita ayirish misolini yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Sonli va harfli ifodalarni farqlay olishi, sodda ifodaning qiymatini topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sonli va harfli ifodalarni farqlay olishi, sodda ifodaning qiymatini topa olishi.
normatives.example: a=5 bo‘lsa, a+7 ifodaning qiymatini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Qavsli sodda ifodalarda amallar tartibiga rioya qilib hisoblay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qavsli sodda ifodalarda amallar tartibiga rioya qilib hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: (8+4)−5 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Sodda tenglama va tengsizliklarni yecha olishi, sonlar orasida katta, kichik va teng…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sodda tenglama va tengsizliklarni yecha olishi, sonlar orasida katta, kichik va teng munosabatni aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: x+4=11 tenglamani yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 1 amalli matnli masalada shart, savol, yechim va javobni ajrata olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 1 amalli matnli masalada shart, savol, yechim va javobni ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: Ali 6 ta daftar oldi, Vali 4 ta daftar oldi. Ular jami nechta daftar oldi?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Butun-qism munosabatiga oid masalalarda butunni yoki noma’lum qismni topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi butun-qism munosabatiga oid masalalarda butunni yoki noma’lum qismni topa olishi.
normatives.example: Jami 12 ta gul bor. 5 tasi qizil, qolganlari oq. Nechta oq gul bor?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: “... taga ko‘p”, “... taga kam” va taqqoslashga oid masalalarni yecha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi “... taga ko‘p”, “... taga kam” va taqqoslashga oid masalalarni yecha olishi.
normatives.example: Madinada 9 ta qalam, Azizda 6 ta qalam bor. Madinada nechta qalam ko‘p?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ikki amalli sodda masalada amallar ketma-ketligini to‘g‘ri tanlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ikki amalli sodda masalada amallar ketma-ketligini to‘g‘ri tanlay olishi.
normatives.example: Ali 5 ta olma oldi, keyin yana 4 ta oldi, 3 tasini yedi. Unda nechta olma qoldi?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Santimetr, desimetr, kilogramm va litr kabi kattaliklarni farqlay olishi hamda sodda…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi santimetr, desimetr, kilogramm va litr kabi kattaliklarni farqlay olishi hamda sodda o‘lchash masalalarini yecha olishi.
normatives.example: 1 dm necha sm? 8 kg va 5 kg ni taqqoslang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Kesmani o‘lchay olishi, berilgan uzunlikdagi kesma chiza olishi va siniq chiziq…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kesmani o‘lchay olishi, berilgan uzunlikdagi kesma chiza olishi va siniq chiziq uzunligini topa olishi.
normatives.example: Bo‘g‘inlari 3 sm, 4 sm va 2 sm bo‘lgan siniq chiziq uzunligini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘pburchakni taniy olishi, tomonlari va uchlarini ajratishi, sodda perimetrni hisoblay…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘pburchakni taniy olishi, tomonlari va uchlarini ajratishi, sodda perimetrni hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: Tomonlari 3 sm, 4 sm va 5 sm bo‘lgan uchburchak perimetrini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: To‘g‘ri burchak, o‘tkir burchak, o‘tmas burchak, to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak va kvadratni…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi to‘g‘ri burchak, o‘tkir burchak, o‘tmas burchak, to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak va kvadratni farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Kvadrat va to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchakning asosiy farqini ayting.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Yassi va hajmli figuralarni farqlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yassi va hajmli figuralarni farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Doira, kvadrat, kub va shar ichidan hajmli figuralarni ajrating.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Simmetrik shakllarni taniy olishi va sodda shaklda simmetriya o‘qini ko‘rsata olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi simmetrik shakllarni taniy olishi va sodda shaklda simmetriya o‘qini ko‘rsata olishi.
normatives.example: Kvadratning simmetriya o‘qlaridan bittasini chizing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Rim raqamlarining sodda yozuvlarini taniy olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi Rim raqamlarining sodda yozuvlarini taniy olishi.
normatives.example: IV, V, IX sonlarini oddiy raqam bilan yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Sodda mantiqiy masalalarda qonuniyatni davom ettira olishi va ortiqcha predmetni ajrata…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sodda mantiqiy masalalarda qonuniyatni davom ettira olishi va ortiqcha predmetni ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: 2, 4, 6, 8, □ ketma-ketlikda keyingi sonni toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 100 gacha sonlarni qo‘shish va ayirishni og‘zaki va yozma bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 100 gacha sonlarni qo‘shish va ayirishni og‘zaki va yozma bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 47+28 va 83−36 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Sonni to‘liq o‘nlikka yetkazib qo‘shish va to‘liq o‘nlikdan ayirish usulidan foydalana…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sonni to‘liq o‘nlikka yetkazib qo‘shish va to‘liq o‘nlikdan ayirish usulidan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: 38+7 va 50−6 ni qulay usulda hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ikki xonali sonlarni ustun ko‘rinishida qo‘shish va ayirishni bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ikki xonali sonlarni ustun ko‘rinishida qo‘shish va ayirishni bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 56+27 va 84−39 ni ustun usulida hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Qo‘shish va ayirish xossalari hamda teskari amallar bog‘lanishidan foydalana olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qo‘shish va ayirish xossalari hamda teskari amallar bog‘lanishidan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: 35+□=72 tenglikda □ ni toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Sonli va harfli ifodalarni farqlay olishi, sodda ifoda qiymatini topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sonli va harfli ifodalarni farqlay olishi, sodda ifoda qiymatini topa olishi.
normatives.example: a=6 bo‘lsa, a+18 ifodaning qiymatini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Qo‘shish va ayirishga oid sodda tenglamalarni yecha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qo‘shish va ayirishga oid sodda tenglamalarni yecha olishi.
normatives.example: x−24=37 tenglamani yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 1–2 amalli matnli masalalarda shart, savol, yechim va javobni ajrata olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 1–2 amalli matnli masalalarda shart, savol, yechim va javobni ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: Ali 28 ta, Vali undan 15 ta ko‘p olma terdi. Vali nechta olma terdi?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Uch xonali sonlarni o‘qiy olishi, yoza olishi, taqqoslay olishi va razryadlarini ajrata…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi uch xonali sonlarni o‘qiy olishi, yoza olishi, taqqoslay olishi va razryadlarini ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: 486 sonida yuzlik, o‘nlik va birliklarni ayting.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Uch xonali sonlarni qo‘shish va ayirishni bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi uch xonali sonlarni qo‘shish va ayirishni bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 346+218 va 725−486 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Bir nechta sonlarni ustun ko‘rinishida qo‘sha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi bir nechta sonlarni ustun ko‘rinishida qo‘sha olishi.
normatives.example: 128+246+317 ni ustun usulida hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Metr, detsimetr, santimetr, millimetr va kilometr birliklari orasidagi bog‘lanishlarni…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi metr, detsimetr, santimetr, millimetr va kilometr birliklari orasidagi bog‘lanishlarni qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: 3 m 25 sm ni santimetrda yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Soat, daqiqa va soniya birliklari bilan sodda hisoblashlarni bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi soat, daqiqa va soniya birliklari bilan sodda hisoblashlarni bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 1 soat 20 daqiqa necha daqiqa?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: To‘g‘ri chiziq, egri chiziq, siniq chiziq, nur va kesmani farqlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi to‘g‘ri chiziq, egri chiziq, siniq chiziq, nur va kesmani farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Chizmada to‘g‘ri chiziq, nur va kesmani ajrating.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Siniq chiziq uzunligi va ko‘pburchak perimetrini hisoblay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi siniq chiziq uzunligi va ko‘pburchak perimetrini hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: Tomonlari 5 sm, 7 sm va 8 sm bo‘lgan uchburchak perimetrini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Burchak, to‘g‘ri burchak, to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak va kvadratni taniy olishi, katakli…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi burchak, to‘g‘ri burchak, to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak va kvadratni taniy olishi, katakli qog‘ozda sodda shakl yasay olishi.
normatives.example: 4 sm va 3 sm tomonli to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak chizing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Yuza tushunchasini bilishi va katakli qog‘ozda shakl yuzini sanab topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yuza tushunchasini bilishi va katakli qog‘ozda shakl yuzini sanab topa olishi.
normatives.example: 4×3 katakli to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak yuzini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: To‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak yuzini hisoblay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak yuzini hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: Uzunligi 8 sm, eni 5 sm bo‘lgan to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak yuzini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘paytirish tushunchasini teng qo‘shiluvchilar yig‘indisi sifatida tushunishi va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘paytirish tushunchasini teng qo‘shiluvchilar yig‘indisi sifatida tushunishi va ko‘paytirish jadvalidan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: 6×7 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Bo‘lish tushunchasini teng taqsimlash sifatida tushunishi va 2 dan 9 gacha bo‘lishlarni…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi bo‘lish tushunchasini teng taqsimlash sifatida tushunishi va 2 dan 9 gacha bo‘lishlarni bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 48:6 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘paytirish va bo‘lish bog‘lanishini tushunishi, juft va toq sonlarni farqlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘paytirish va bo‘lish bog‘lanishini tushunishi, juft va toq sonlarni farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: 7×8=56 bo‘lsa, 56:8 nechaga teng?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘paytirishning o‘rin almashtirish, taqsimot, 0 va 1 xossalaridan foydalana olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘paytirishning o‘rin almashtirish, taqsimot, 0 va 1 xossalaridan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: 4×(10+3) ni taqsimot xossasi bilan hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ikki amalli ifodalarda amallar tartibiga rioya qilib hisoblay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ikki amalli ifodalarda amallar tartibiga rioya qilib hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: 6×4+18:3 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 10 va 100 ga ko‘paytirish va bo‘lishni bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 10 va 100 ga ko‘paytirish va bo‘lishni bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 45×10 va 800:100 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Yuzlik sonlarni ko‘paytirish va bo‘lishni bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yuzlik sonlarni ko‘paytirish va bo‘lishni bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 300×4 va 900:3 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ikki xonali sonni bir xonali songa ko‘paytira olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ikki xonali sonni bir xonali songa ko‘paytira olishi.
normatives.example: 24×3 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Bo‘luvchilar va karralarni sodda holatlarda aniqlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi bo‘luvchilar va karralarni sodda holatlarda aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: 18 soni 3 ga bo‘linadimi? 5 ning uchta karrasini yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Hajmli figuralar, doira va aylanani farqlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hajmli figuralar, doira va aylanani farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Kub, shar, silindr, doira va aylanadan qaysilari hajmli figura?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: 1000 gacha va ko‘p xonali sonlarni o‘qiy olishi, yoza olishi, razryadlarini ajratishi va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi 1000 gacha va ko‘p xonali sonlarni o‘qiy olishi, yoza olishi, razryadlarini ajratishi va taqqoslay olishi.
normatives.example: 36 408 sonini o‘qing, minglar xonasidagi raqamni ayting va 36 408 > 34 980 ni tekshiring.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘p xonali sonni razryadli qo‘shiluvchilar yig‘indisi ko‘rinishida yoza olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘p xonali sonni razryadli qo‘shiluvchilar yig‘indisi ko‘rinishida yoza olishi.
normatives.example: 58 306 sonini razryadli qo‘shiluvchilar yig‘indisi ko‘rinishida yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘p xonali sonlarni ustun usulida qo‘shish va ayirishni bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘p xonali sonlarni ustun usulida qo‘shish va ayirishni bajara olishi.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘paytirishning 0 va 1 xossalari, taqsimot xossasi hamda 10, 100, 1000 ga ko‘paytirish…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘paytirishning 0 va 1 xossalari, taqsimot xossasi hamda 10, 100, 1000 ga ko‘paytirish va bo‘lishni qo‘llay olishi.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ikki, uch va ko‘p xonali sonlarni bir xonali songa ko‘paytira olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ikki, uch va ko‘p xonali sonlarni bir xonali songa ko‘paytira olishi.
normatives.example: 3 426×7 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ikki xonali sonni ikki xonali songa va ko‘p xonali sonni uch xonali songa ko‘paytira…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ikki xonali sonni ikki xonali songa va ko‘p xonali sonni uch xonali songa ko‘paytira olishi.
normatives.example: 248×36 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Nol bilan tugaydigan va o‘rtasida nol bo‘lgan sonlarni ko‘paytirish hamda bo‘lishda…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi nol bilan tugaydigan va o‘rtasida nol bo‘lgan sonlarni ko‘paytirish hamda bo‘lishda xatoga yo‘l qo‘ymasligi.
normatives.example: 4 080×6 va 7 200:90 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Yig‘indini songa bo‘lish, qoldiqli bo‘lish va qoldiqni tekshirishni bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yig‘indini songa bo‘lish, qoldiqli bo‘lish va qoldiqni tekshirishni bajara olishi.
normatives.example: 57:8 ni qoldiq bilan hisoblang va tekshiring.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘p xonali sonlarni ustun usulida bo‘la olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘p xonali sonlarni ustun usulida bo‘la olishi.
normatives.example: 7 245:15 ni ustun usulida hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Bo‘luvchilar va karralarni topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi bo‘luvchilar va karralarni topa olishi.
normatives.example: 24 ning bo‘luvchilaridan 4 tasini va 6 ning dastlabki 4 ta karrasini yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Narx, miqdor va qiymat orasidagi bog‘lanishdan foydalanib masala yecha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi narx, miqdor va qiymat orasidagi bog‘lanishdan foydalanib masala yecha olishi.
normatives.example: 1 ta daftar 4 000 so‘m. 7 ta daftar necha so‘m bo‘ladi?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Vaqt birliklari, soat, daqiqa va soniya orasidagi bog‘lanishlarni qo‘llay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi vaqt birliklari, soat, daqiqa va soniya orasidagi bog‘lanishlarni qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: 2 soat 35 daqiqa necha daqiqa?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Uzunlik, massa, yuza va hajm birliklarini almashtira olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi uzunlik, massa, yuza va hajm birliklarini almashtira olishi.
normatives.example: 3 kg 250 g ni grammda, 4 m 20 sm ni santimetrda yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Kesmani teng qismlarga bo‘la olishi va sonning ulushini topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kesmani teng qismlarga bo‘la olishi va sonning ulushini topa olishi.
normatives.example: 48 ning 1/6 qismini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: To‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak, kvadrat va nostandart shakllarning perimetrini hisoblay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak, kvadrat va nostandart shakllarning perimetrini hisoblay olishi.

normatives.name: Fales teoremasi, proporsional kesmalar va uchburchak hamda trapetsiya o‘rta chizig‘ini…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi Fales teoremasi, proporsional kesmalar va uchburchak hamda trapetsiya o‘rta chizig‘ini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Uchburchakda o‘rta chiziq 8 sm bo‘lsa, unga parallel uchinchi tomon uzunligini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Pifagor teoremasi va to‘g‘ri burchakli uchburchak trigonometrik nisbatlarini qo‘llay…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi Pifagor teoremasi va to‘g‘ri burchakli uchburchak trigonometrik nisbatlarini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Katetlari 6 sm va 8 sm bo‘lgan to‘g‘ri burchakli uchburchak gipotenuzasini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Koordinata tekisligida masofa, aylana tenglamasi va to‘g‘ri chiziq tenglamasidan…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi koordinata tekisligida masofa, aylana tenglamasi va to‘g‘ri chiziq tenglamasidan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: A(1;2), B(4;6). AB masofani toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Vektor koordinatalari, uzunligi va vektorlar ustida amallarni bajara olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi vektor koordinatalari, uzunligi va vektorlar ustida amallarni bajara olishi.
normatives.example: a=(2;−3), b=(4;1). a+b ni toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: To‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak, parallelogramm, uchburchak, romb, trapetsiya va ko‘pburchak…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak, parallelogramm, uchburchak, romb, trapetsiya va ko‘pburchak yuzalarini hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: Asoslari 8 sm va 12 sm, balandligi 5 sm bo‘lgan trapetsiya yuzini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Aylana, urinma, xorda, diametr, markaziy va ichki chizilgan burchaklar xossalarini…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi aylana, urinma, xorda, diametr, markaziy va ichki chizilgan burchaklar xossalarini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Aylanada markaziy burchak 100° bo‘lsa, shu yoyga tiralgan ichki chizilgan burchakni toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Kvadrat funksiyani taniy olishi, parabola yo‘nalishi, uch nuqtasi, simmetriya o‘qi va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kvadrat funksiyani taniy olishi, parabola yo‘nalishi, uch nuqtasi, simmetriya o‘qi va asosiy xossalarini aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: y=x²−4x+3 funksiyaning uch nuqtasi va simmetriya o‘qini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Kvadrat funksiya grafigini yasay olishi va grafik orqali funksiya qiymatining musbat…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kvadrat funksiya grafigini yasay olishi va grafik orqali funksiya qiymatining musbat, manfiy yoki nol bo‘ladigan oraliqlarini aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: y=x²−5x+6 funksiyaning nollari asosida grafigini tasavvur qiling va y>0 bo‘ladigan oraliqlarni yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Kvadrat tengsizliklar, darajali tengsizliklar va oraliqlar usulini qo‘llay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kvadrat tengsizliklar, darajali tengsizliklar va oraliqlar usulini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: (x−2)(x+3)>0 tengsizlikni yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasi, o‘sish-kamayish oraliqlari, juft-toqligi va asosiy…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasi, o‘sish-kamayish oraliqlari, juft-toqligi va asosiy xossalarini aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: f(x)=√(x−2)/(x+1) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ikkinchi darajali tenglama qatnashgan sodda sistemalarni turli usullar bilan yecha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ikkinchi darajali tenglama qatnashgan sodda sistemalarni turli usullar bilan yecha olishi.
normatives.example: y=x+1 va y=x²−3 tenglamalar sistemasini yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Tengsizliklar sistemasini yechib, umumiy yechimni oraliq ko‘rinishida yoza olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi tengsizliklar sistemasini yechib, umumiy yechimni oraliq ko‘rinishida yoza olishi.
normatives.example: x²−4≤0 va x−1>0 tengsizliklar sistemasini yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Sodda tengsizliklarni mantiqiy asoslab isbotlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sodda tengsizliklarni mantiqiy asoslab isbotlay olishi.
normatives.example: Istalgan x uchun x²+4≥4x ekanini isbotlang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Funksiya, tenglama, tengsizlik yoki sistema yordamida amaliy masalani matematik modelga…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi funksiya, tenglama, tengsizlik yoki sistema yordamida amaliy masalani matematik modelga aylantira olishi.
normatives.example: Tomonlari x va x+3 bo‘lgan to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak yuzi 40 sm². Tenglama tuzing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Burchakning radian o‘lchovi va koordinatalar boshiga nisbatan aylantirish qoidalarini…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi burchakning radian o‘lchovi va koordinatalar boshiga nisbatan aylantirish qoidalarini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: 150° ni radianlarda ifodalang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Sinus, kosinus, tangens va kotangens ta’riflari, ishoralari va asosiy trigonometrik…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sinus, kosinus, tangens va kotangens ta’riflari, ishoralari va asosiy trigonometrik bog‘lanishlardan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: Agar sin α=3/5 va α I chorakda bo‘lsa, cos α ni toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Trigonometrik ayniyatlar, keltirish formulalari, yig‘indi va ikki burchak formulalarini…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi trigonometrik ayniyatlar, keltirish formulalari, yig‘indi va ikki burchak formulalarini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: sin²α+cos²α+tg45° ifodaning qiymatini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Trigonometrik nisbatlar va formulalar yordamida amaliy masalalarda balandlik, masofa yoki…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi trigonometrik nisbatlar va formulalar yordamida amaliy masalalarda balandlik, masofa yoki burchakni topa olishi.
normatives.example: Daraxt soyasi 6 m, quyosh nuri yer bilan 45° burchak hosil qiladi. Daraxt balandligini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Sonli ketma-ketlikni taniy olishi, arifmetik progressiyaning hadi va yig‘indisini…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sonli ketma-ketlikni taniy olishi, arifmetik progressiyaning hadi va yig‘indisini hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: a₁=4, d=3. Arifmetik progressiyaning a₁₀ hadini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Geometrik progressiyaning hadi, yig‘indisi va cheksiz kamayuvchi progressiya yig‘indisini…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi geometrik progressiyaning hadi, yig‘indisi va cheksiz kamayuvchi progressiya yig‘indisini hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: b₁=3, q=2. Geometrik progressiyaning b₅ hadini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Hodisa, ehtimol, nisbiy chastota va tasodifiy miqdor tushunchalarini qo‘llab, sodda…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hodisa, ehtimol, nisbiy chastota va tasodifiy miqdor tushunchalarini qo‘llab, sodda ehtimollik masalalarini yecha olishi.
normatives.example: Kubik tashlanganda 3 dan katta son tushish ehtimolini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: O‘xshash uchburchaklar va o‘xshash ko‘pburchaklar xossalaridan foydalanib noma’lum tomon…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘xshash uchburchaklar va o‘xshash ko‘pburchaklar xossalaridan foydalanib noma’lum tomon, perimetr yoki yuza nisbatini topa olishi.
normatives.example: O‘xshash ikki uchburchakda mos tomonlar nisbati 2:3. Kichik uchburchak perimetri 18 sm bo‘lsa, katta uchburchak perimetrini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Tekislikdagi geometrik almashtirishlar, parallel ko‘chirish, markaziy simmetriya…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi tekislikdagi geometrik almashtirishlar, parallel ko‘chirish, markaziy simmetriya, aylantirish va gomotetiyani qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: A(2;−3) nuqtani koordinatalar boshiga nisbatan 180° ga aylantiring.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Uchburchak yuzasi, sinuslar teoremasi va kosinuslar teoremasidan foydalanib…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi uchburchak yuzasi, sinuslar teoremasi va kosinuslar teoremasidan foydalanib uchburchaklarni yecha olishi.
normatives.example: a=5, b=7, ular orasidagi burchak 60°. Uchburchak yuzini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Vektorlarning skalyar ko‘paytmasi va ikki vektor orasidagi burchakni topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi vektorlarning skalyar ko‘paytmasi va ikki vektor orasidagi burchakni topa olishi.
normatives.example: a=(2;3), b=(4;−1). a·b ni toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Aylana, doira, muntazam ko‘pburchak va doira qismlariga oid uzunlik hamda yuza…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi aylana, doira, muntazam ko‘pburchak va doira qismlariga oid uzunlik hamda yuza masalalarini yecha olishi.
normatives.example: Radiusi 6 sm bo‘lgan doiraning yuzini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Aylana ichidagi, tashqarisidagi va proporsional kesmalar bilan bog‘liq masalalarni yecha…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi aylana ichidagi, tashqarisidagi va proporsional kesmalar bilan bog‘liq masalalarni yecha olishi.
normatives.example: Aylana ichida kesishuvchi ikki xorda bo‘laklari 3 sm va 8 sm, ikkinchi xordaning bir bo‘lagi 4 sm. Ikkinchi bo‘lagini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Funksiya tushunchasini, aniqlanish sohasi, qiymatlar to‘plami va funksiya berilish…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi funksiya tushunchasini, aniqlanish sohasi, qiymatlar to‘plami va funksiya berilish usullarini aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: f(x)=√(x−3)/(x−5). Funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Funksiyalar ustida amallar bajarib, murakkab va teskari funksiyani topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi funksiyalar ustida amallar bajarib, murakkab va teskari funksiyani topa olishi.
normatives.example: f(x)=2x−1, g(x)=x². f(g(x)) ni toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Funksiya xossalari va grafik o‘zgarishlarini tahlil qila olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi funksiya xossalari va grafik o‘zgarishlarini tahlil qila olishi.
normatives.example: y=(x−2)²+3 grafigi y=x² grafigidan qanday hosil bo‘lganini ayting.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Chiziqli va kvadratik model tuzib, amaliy vaziyatni tenglama yoki funksiya orqali…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi chiziqli va kvadratik model tuzib, amaliy vaziyatni tenglama yoki funksiya orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: Narxi 5000 so‘m bo‘lgan daftarlar soni x ta bo‘lsa, umumiy xarajat funksiyasini yozing.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ratsional tenglama va ratsional tenglamalar sistemasini yecha olishi, begona ildizlarni…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ratsional tenglama va ratsional tenglamalar sistemasini yecha olishi, begona ildizlarni tekshira olishi.
normatives.example: (x+1)/(x−2)=3 tenglamani yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ratsional tengsizlik va ratsional tengsizliklar sistemasini oraliqlar usuli bilan yecha…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ratsional tengsizlik va ratsional tengsizliklar sistemasini oraliqlar usuli bilan yecha olishi.
normatives.example: (x−3)/(x+2)>0 tengsizlikni yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Irratsional tenglama va irratsional tenglamalar sistemasini yecha olishi, aniqlanish…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi irratsional tenglama va irratsional tenglamalar sistemasini yecha olishi, aniqlanish shartlarini tekshira olishi.
normatives.example: √(x+5)=x−1 tenglamani yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Darajali funksiya, darajali tenglama va daraja xossalarini qo‘llay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi darajali funksiya, darajali tenglama va daraja xossalarini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: 2^(x+1)=16 tenglamani yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Logarifm xossalarini qo‘llab, logarifmik ifodalarni soddalashtira olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi logarifm xossalarini qo‘llab, logarifmik ifodalarni soddalashtira olishi.
normatives.example: log₂32−log₂4 ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Logarifmik tenglama, tengsizlik va sistemalarni yecha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi logarifmik tenglama, tengsizlik va sistemalarni yecha olishi.
normatives.example: log₃(x−1)=2 tenglamani yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Darajali va logarifmik funksiyalar yordamida amaliy model tuza olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi darajali va logarifmik funksiyalar yordamida amaliy model tuza olishi.
normatives.example: Aholi soni har yili 5% ga oshsa, boshlang‘ich soni 10000 bo‘lgan aholi uchun 2 yildan keyingi sonni ifodalang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Trigonometrik va teskari trigonometrik funksiyalarning asosiy xossalarini bilishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi trigonometrik va teskari trigonometrik funksiyalarning asosiy xossalarini bilishi.
normatives.example: sin x funksiyaning davri va qiymatlar to‘plamini ayting.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Eng sodda va asosiy usullarga keltiriladigan trigonometrik tenglamalarni yecha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi eng sodda va asosiy usullarga keltiriladigan trigonometrik tenglamalarni yecha olishi.
normatives.example: 2sin x=1, 0°≤x≤360° tenglamani yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Trigonometrik tengsizliklarni birlik aylana yoki grafik yordamida yecha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi trigonometrik tengsizliklarni birlik aylana yoki grafik yordamida yecha olishi.
normatives.example: sin x>0, 0°≤x≤360° tengsizlikni yeching.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ehtimollikning asosiy ta’rifini qo‘llab, tasodifiy hodisa ehtimolini hisoblay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ehtimollikning asosiy ta’rifini qo‘llab, tasodifiy hodisa ehtimolini hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: Kubik tashlanganda juft son tushish ehtimolini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Geometrik ta’rif, aksioma, teorema va isbot mantiqidan to‘g‘ri foydalana olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi geometrik ta’rif, aksioma, teorema va isbot mantiqidan to‘g‘ri foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: “Agar ikki to‘g‘ri chiziq kesishsa, ular bitta umumiy nuqtaga ega” jumlasida shart va xulosani ajrating.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Stereometriyaning asosiy tushunchalarini, fazoda nuqta, to‘g‘ri chiziq va tekisliklarning…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi stereometriyaning asosiy tushunchalarini, fazoda nuqta, to‘g‘ri chiziq va tekisliklarning o‘zaro joylashuvini aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Kubda bir-biriga ayqash bo‘lgan ikki qirrani ko‘rsating.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ko‘pyoqlarni taniy olishi, ularning elementlari, chizmasi, modeli va oddiy kesimlarini…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ko‘pyoqlarni taniy olishi, ularning elementlari, chizmasi, modeli va oddiy kesimlarini tasvirlay olishi.
normatives.example: Kubning uchta nuqtadan o‘tuvchi kesimi uchburchak bo‘lishi mumkinmi? Chizmada ko‘rsating.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Fazoda parallel proyeksiya va ortogonal proyeksiyani farqlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi fazoda parallel proyeksiya va ortogonal proyeksiyani farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Kesmaning tekislikdagi ortogonal proyeksiyasi qanday hosil bo‘lishini tushuntiring.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Fazoda perpendikulyarlik, og‘ma, masofa va uch perpendikulyar teoremasidan foydalana…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi fazoda perpendikulyarlik, og‘ma, masofa va uch perpendikulyar teoremasidan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: Nuqtadan tekislikka tushirilgan perpendikulyar 6 sm, og‘ma 10 sm. Og‘maning proyeksiyasini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Limit, funksiya orttirmasi va hosilaning boshlang‘ich ma’nosini tushuntira olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi limit, funksiya orttirmasi va hosilaning boshlang‘ich ma’nosini tushuntira olishi.
normatives.example: f(x)=x². (f(3+h)−f(3))/h ni soddalashtiring va h→0 bo‘lganda natijani ayting.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Asosiy va murakkab funksiyalarning hosilasini topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi asosiy va murakkab funksiyalarning hosilasini topa olishi.
normatives.example: y=(2x²−3x+1)⁵ funksiyaning hosilasini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Hosila yordamida funksiya grafigini tahlil qila olishi, urinma, kritik nuqta, monotonlik…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hosila yordamida funksiya grafigini tahlil qila olishi, urinma, kritik nuqta, monotonlik va ekstremumni aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: f(x)=x³−6x²+9x funksiyaning kritik nuqtalarini va ekstremumlarini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Hosila yordamida amaliy yoki ekstremal masalani matematik modelga aylantirib yecha olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hosila yordamida amaliy yoki ekstremal masalani matematik modelga aylantirib yecha olishi.
normatives.example: Perimetri 24 sm bo‘lgan to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchakning yuzi eng katta bo‘lishi uchun tomonlari qanday bo‘lishi kerak?

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Boshlang‘ich funksiya va aniqmas integralni topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi boshlang‘ich funksiya va aniqmas integralni topa olishi.
normatives.example: ∫(6x²−4x+7)dx ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Aniq integralni hisoblay olishi va uni yuza, yo‘l yoki amaliy kattalikni topishda qo‘llay…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi aniq integralni hisoblay olishi va uni yuza, yo‘l yoki amaliy kattalikni topishda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: ∫₁³(2x+1)dx ni hisoblang.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Kombinatorik sanash usullarini va Nyuton binomini qo‘llay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kombinatorik sanash usullarini va Nyuton binomini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: (x+2)⁵ yoyilmasidagi x³ had koeffitsientini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Statistik ma’lumotlarni tahlil qila olishi, o‘rtacha qiymat, mediana, moda va tarqoqlikni…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi statistik ma’lumotlarni tahlil qila olishi, o‘rtacha qiymat, mediana, moda va tarqoqlikni hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: 4, 6, 6, 8, 11 sonlari uchun o‘rtacha qiymat, mediana va modani toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Ehtimollikning asosiy qoidalarini qo‘llab, oddiy va murakkab hodisalar ehtimolini…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ehtimollikning asosiy qoidalarini qo‘llab, oddiy va murakkab hodisalar ehtimolini hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: Qutida 5 ta oq va 3 ta qora shar bor. Tasodifan olingan shar oq bo‘lish ehtimolini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Binomial taqsimot g‘oyasini tushunib, mustaqil takroriy tajribalarda ehtimolni hisoblay…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi binomial taqsimot g‘oyasini tushunib, mustaqil takroriy tajribalarda ehtimolni hisoblay olishi.
normatives.example: Tanga 4 marta tashlandi. Aynan 2 marta gerb tushish ehtimolini toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Fazoda koordinatalar usulidan foydalanib, masofa va o‘rta nuqtani topa olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi fazoda koordinatalar usulidan foydalanib, masofa va o‘rta nuqtani topa olishi.
normatives.example: A(1;2;3), B(5;4;7). AB masofani toping.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Fazodagi vektorlar ustida amallar bajarib, skalyar ko‘paytma, uzunlik, burchak va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi fazodagi vektorlar ustida amallar bajarib, skalyar ko‘paytma, uzunlik, burchak va kollinearlikni aniqlay olishi.

normatives.subject: matematika
normatives.name: Fazodagi geometrik almashtirishlar, simmetriya va o‘xshashlikni tushunib qo‘llay olishi

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Odam, hayvon va predmet belgilarini “has got”, “hasn’t got”, “it’s got” shakllari orqali…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi odam, hayvon va predmet belgilarini “has got”, “hasn’t got”, “it’s got” shakllari orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: He’s got blond hair. She hasn’t got a hat. It’s got big ears. It hasn’t got legs kabi gaplarni rasmga qarab ayta olish,o'zini va oila azo'larini ta'riflab berish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Yoqtirish va yoqtirmaslikka oid sodda gaplar hamda savol-javoblardan foydalana olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yoqtirish va yoqtirmaslikka oid sodda gaplar hamda savol-javoblardan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: I like monkeys. I don’t like elephants. Do you like carrots? Yes, I do. No, I don’t. What do you like? I like yogurt kabi suzlar yordamida dialog tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Harakat va qobiliyatni “can”, “can’t” va “Let’s...” shakllari bilan ifodalay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi harakat va qobiliyatni “can”, “can’t” va “Let’s...” shakllari bilan ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: It can run. It can’t fly. Can he talk? Yes, he can. No, he can’t. Let’s play ball. Let’s swim.Can va can't modal fe'llari yordamida gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ingliz alifbosidagi katta va kichik harflarni taniy olishi, nomlay olishi…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ingliz alifbosidagi katta va kichik harflarni taniy olishi, nomlay olishi, ketma-ketligini bilishi va juftligini topa olishi.
normatives.example: Aa–Zz harflarini ko‘rsatish, katta-kichik juftligini topish va alifbo ketma-ketligida joylashtish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ingliz harflarini chiziq yo‘nalishiga rioya qilgan holda yozishi, harfni aytishi va mos…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ingliz harflarini chiziq yo‘nalishiga rioya qilgan holda yozishi, harfni aytishi va mos rasm bilan bog‘lay olishi.
normatives.example: Aa, Bb, Cc, Dd, Mm, Ss, Ww, Zz harflarini namunaga qarab yozish, nomini aytish va mos rasm bilan ulash.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: A–Z harflarining boshlang‘ich tovushlarini ajrata olishi va rasmli so‘zning qaysi tovush…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi A–Z harflarining boshlang‘ich tovushlarini ajrata olishi va rasmli so‘zning qaysi tovush bilan boshlanishini aniqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Apple, bird, cat, dog, egg, fish, goat, hat, ink, jam, kite, lion, mum, nurse, orange, pen, queen, rabbit, sofa, teddy, umbrella, van, window, box, yo-yo, zebra rasmlariga mos boshlang‘ich tovushni aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Bir xil boshlang‘ich tovush, a/e/i/o/u unli tovushlari, sh/ch/th tovushlari va CVC…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi bir xil boshlang‘ich tovush, a/e/i/o/u unli tovushlari, sh/ch/th tovushlari va CVC so‘zlarni eshitib-o‘qib farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Sh, ch, th tovushlarini shoes, chair, three so‘zlarida ajrating; cat, pen, bin, dog, rug kabi CVC so‘zlarni o‘qing va mos rasmga ulang; a/e/i/o/u tovushlarini so‘z ichida ko‘rsatish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Sodda so‘z, gap, dialog, hikoya va qisqa matnlarni o‘qib, asosiy ma’nosini tushuna olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sodda so‘z, gap, dialog, hikoya va qisqa matnlarni o‘qib, asosiy ma’nosini tushuna olishi.
normatives.example: It’s a pen. This is my mum. Where’s the kite? I like monkeys. kabi 8 ta gapni o‘qish; 1 ta qisqa story yoki dialogni rasm bilan moslash.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Tinglangan matn yoki dialogdan kerakli ma’lumotni ajrata olishi, sodda gapni so‘zlarga…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi tinglangan matn yoki dialogdan kerakli ma’lumotni ajrata olishi, sodda gapni so‘zlarga ajrata olishi hamda bosh harf, nuqta, savol belgisi, qisqartma va a/an shakllarini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Qisqa matnni tinglang va kerakli rasmni belgilash. My name’s Ali. Is it your teddy? Where’s Grandma? gaplarida so‘zlarni ajratish, bosh harf, nuqta va savol belgisini qo‘yish; a pen, an apple shakllarini to‘ldirish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘tilgan mavzular asosida namunaga qarab sodda gaplar yozishi hamda rasm, maket yoki…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘tilgan mavzular asosida namunaga qarab sodda gaplar yozishi hamda rasm, maket yoki poster yordamida qisqa taqdimot qila olishi.
normatives.example: My school things, my family, my bedroom, food I like yoki what I can do mavzularidan biri bo‘yicha 3–5 ta gap yozish va 4–5 ta gap bilan og‘zaki aytib berish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ingliz tili darsida ishlatiladigan asosiy ko‘rsatmalarni tushunishi, bajarishi, eshitgan…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ingliz tili darsida ishlatiladigan asosiy ko‘rsatmalarni tushunishi, bajarishi, eshitgan so‘z va gaplarni takrorlay olishi.
normatives.example: Listen, point, repeat, read, write, circle, check, number, ask, answer, sing, act ko‘rsatmalarini bajarish va 6 ta qisqa gapni tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Salomlashish, o‘zini va do‘stini tanishtirish, yoshi, oilasi va tashqi belgilarini sodda…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi salomlashish, o‘zini va do‘stini tanishtirish, yoshi, oilasi va tashqi belgilarini sodda gaplar bilan ayta olishi.
normatives.example: Hello. My name’s Ali. I’m eight. This is my friend. He’s nine. She’s got curly hair. He’s got green eyes kabi gaplar tuzish va oila a'zolarini tashqi ko'rinishini tariflab berish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Hafta kunlari, 1 dan 100 gacha sonlar, ranglar va tanish o‘yinchoqlarni taniy olishi…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hafta kunlari, 1 dan 100 gacha sonlar, ranglar va tanish o‘yinchoqlarni taniy olishi, sanay olishi va savol-javobda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Monday–Sunday kunlarini aytish, What colour is number 18? How many cars are there? savollariga javob berish.Dars xonasidagi barcha naslarni nomini va rangini aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Kitoblarda berilgan asosiy rasmli so‘zlarni eshitib taniy olishi, ko‘rsata olishi va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kitoblarda berilgan asosiy rasmli so‘zlarni eshitib taniy olishi, ko‘rsata olishi va inglizcha nomlay olishi.
normatives.example: School things, feelings, outdoor activities, food, school subjects, rooms, after-school activities, special days, daily activities, places, weather, clothes, celebrations, farm animals, people mavzularidan 45 ta rasm ko‘rsatiladi, kamida 36 tasiga javob berish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Predmet va joylarni “This is...”, “That is...”, “These are...”, “Those are...” shakllari…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi predmet va joylarni “This is...”, “That is...”, “These are...”, “Those are...” shakllari bilan birlik-ko‘plikka mos ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: This is a computer. That is a board. These are tables. Those are pegs kabi gaplarni rasmga qarab aytish va mos so‘z bilan to‘ldish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Narsa borligini, miqdorini va joylashuvini “There is...”, “There are...”, “Where is...?”…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi narsa borligini, miqdorini va joylashuvini “There is...”, “There are...”, “Where is...?”, “behind”, “in front of”, “next to”, “between” shakllari bilan ayta olishi.
normatives.example: There are three cars. Where’s the skateboard? It’s in front of the table. It’s between the chairs kabi savol-javob qilish va shu predloglar asosida sodda gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Hissiyot va holatlarni “I’m...”, “He’s...”, “She’s...”, “We’re...”, “They’re...”…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hissiyot va holatlarni “I’m...”, “He’s...”, “She’s...”, “We’re...”, “They’re...” shakllarida ayta olishi va savolga javob bera olishi.
normatives.example: Happy, sad, tired, hungry, thirsty, scared so‘zlari bilan Are they happy? Yes, they are. Is he sad? No, he isn’t kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Qobiliyat va harakatlarni “can”, “can’t” shakllari bilan ifodalay olishi hamda tashqi…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qobiliyat va harakatlarni “can”, “can’t” shakllari bilan ifodalay olishi hamda tashqi faoliyatlar haqida sodda gap tuza olishi.
normatives.example: Ride a bike, skateboard, play football, climb, run, swim rasmlariga qarab She can ride a bike. Can he skate? No, he can’t kabi gaplar tuzish va dialog tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: “have got”, “haven’t got”, “has got”, “hasn’t got” shakllari bilan narsa, ovqat, tana…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi “have got”, “haven’t got”, “has got”, “hasn’t got” shakllari bilan narsa, ovqat, tana belgisi va narsaga egalikni ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: Have you got a milkshake? Yes, I have. Has he got grapes? No, he hasn’t. I’ve got brown hair kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Maktab fanlari, sinf xonalari va dars jadvali haqida “What have we got?”, “When have we…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi maktab fanlari, sinf xonalari va dars jadvali haqida “What have we got?”, “When have we got...?”, “We’ve got...” shakllarida gapira olishi.
normatives.example: English, maths, art, music, PE, computer room, classroom so‘zlari bilan What have we got on Monday? We’ve got English. kabi savol-javob qilish va school subjects va classroom mavzusiga oid suzlarga javob berish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Kundalik ishlar, darsdan keyingi mashg‘ulotlar va vaqtni “What’s the time?”, “It’s ...…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kundalik ishlar, darsdan keyingi mashg‘ulotlar va vaqtni “What’s the time?”, “It’s ... o’clock”, “He ... at ... o’clock” shakllarida ayta olishi.
normatives.example: Get up, have breakfast, go to school, visit, read, ride a bike so‘zlari bilan It’s seven o’clock. He has breakfast at eight o’clock kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Yoqtirish, yoqtirmaslik va tanlovni “like”, “don’t like”, “likes”, “doesn’t like”…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yoqtirish, yoqtirmaslik va tanlovni “like”, “don’t like”, “likes”, “doesn’t like” shakllari bilan ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: What does he like? He likes tennis. She doesn’t like football. I like grapes. I don’t like bread kabi gaplar bilan dialog tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Joylar, kasblar va ish joylari haqida “Where does she work?”, “She works in...”, “Does he…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi joylar, kasblar va ish joylari haqida “Where does she work?”, “She works in...”, “Does he work in...?” shakllarida savol-javob qila olishi.
normatives.example: Hospital, school, shop, fire station, police station, teacher, doctor, farmer so‘zlari bilan Where does she work? She works in a hospital kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ob-havo, kiyim va ob-havoga mos harakatni sodda gaplar bilan ifodalay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ob-havo, kiyim va ob-havoga mos harakatni sodda gaplar bilan ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: What’s the weather like? It’s sunny. Put on your coat. Don’t put on your hat. He’s wearing a red shirt kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Hozir bajarilayotgan harakatni “am/is/are + -ing” shaklida ayta olishi va bayram yoki…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hozir bajarilayotgan harakatni “am/is/are + -ing” shaklida ayta olishi va bayram yoki tayyorgarlik holatini tasvirlay olishi.
normatives.example: What are you doing? I’m dancing. What’s she doing? She’s sleeping. They’re getting ready kabi gaplarni rasmga qarab aytish va gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Hayvon, odam va predmetlarni sifatlar bilan tasvirlay olishi, qiyoslashda “bigger than”…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hayvon, odam va predmetlarni sifatlar bilan tasvirlay olishi, qiyoslashda “bigger than”, “smaller than” kabi shakllarni qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: This cow is bigger than that cow. The goat is smaller. It’s nervous. It’s angry kabi gaplarni rasmga qarab tuzish.Sifat qoidalari aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘tgan zamondagi holatlarni “was”, “wasn’t”, “were”, “weren’t”, “There were...”, “There…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘tgan zamondagi holatlarni “was”, “wasn’t”, “were”, “weren’t”, “There were...”, “There weren’t any...” shakllarida ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: I was at home. You weren’t in the garden. There were some children. There weren’t any books kabi gaplarni to‘ldirish va gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Qisqa unli tovushli so‘zlarni o‘qiy olishi, tovushlarni qo‘shib so‘z yasashi, o‘xshash…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qisqa unli tovushli so‘zlarni o‘qiy olishi, tovushlarni qo‘shib so‘z yasashi, o‘xshash talaffuzli so‘zlarni farqlashi va yoza olishi.
normatives.example: Cat, ant, ram, jam, fan, bed, pen, bin, six, fox, pot, sun, jug, cup, nut, run kabi so‘zlarni o‘qing, mos rasmga ulang va 8 tasini yozish. Diktantdan 35 suzdan 30 yoza olish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Digraph, consonant blend, long vowel va short-long vowel farqlarini eshitib-o‘qib ajrata…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi digraph, consonant blend, long vowel va short-long vowel farqlarini eshitib-o‘qib ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: Ch, sh, th; gr, br, fr, dr, tr, cr, fl, pl, bl, cl, gl, sl, sm, sn, st, sk; lake, kite, rope, cube, tree, tap-tape, cub-cube so‘zlarini o‘qish va farqlash.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Sodda matn, dialog, hikoya, she’r, email yoki ma’lumotli matnni o‘qib-tinglab tushunishi…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sodda matn, dialog, hikoya, she’r, email yoki ma’lumotli matnni o‘qib-tinglab tushunishi, kerakli ma’lumotni ajratishi, namunaga qarab qisqa yozuv va og‘zaki taqdimot qila olishi.
normatives.example: Qisqa matnni o‘qing yoki tinglash, 5 ta savolga javob berish; bosh harf, nuqta, savol belgisi, vergul, and/or va qisqartmalarni qo‘llab 4–6 ta gap yozish; rasm yoki poster bo‘yicha 5 ta gap aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ingliz tili darsida ishlatiladigan ko‘rsatmalarni tushunishi, ularga amal qilishi…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ingliz tili darsida ishlatiladigan ko‘rsatmalarni tushunishi, ularga amal qilishi, eshitgan so‘z va gaplarni to‘g‘ri takrorlay olishi.
normatives.example: Listen, point, repeat, read, write, circle, tick, match, ask, answer, sing, act ko‘rsatmalarini bajaring; 6 ta qisqa gapni eshitib takrorlash.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘zi, oilasi, do‘sti, yoshi, tug‘ilgan kuni va oyi haqida sodda gaplar bilan gapira olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘zi, oilasi, do‘sti, yoshi, tug‘ilgan kuni va oyi haqida sodda gaplar bilan gapira olishi.
normatives.example: My name’s Ali. I’m nine. I’ve got a sister. This is my cousin. My birthday is in June. kabi 5 ta gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Oylar, 10 dan 100 gacha sonlar, davlatlar, millatlar, fasllar va uyga oid so‘zlarni taniy…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi oylar, 10 dan 100 gacha sonlar, davlatlar, millatlar, fasllar va uyga oid so‘zlarni taniy olishi va savol-javobda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: January–December oylarini aytish; Where are you from? I’m from Uzbekistan. My favourite season is spring kabi gaplar tuzish va sinf o'quvchilari bilan dialog tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Kitoblarda berilgan asosiy rasmli so‘zlarni eshitib taniy olishi, ko‘rsata olishi va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kitoblarda berilgan asosiy rasmli so‘zlarni eshitib taniy olishi, ko‘rsata olishi va inglizcha nomlay olishi.
normatives.example: Family, countries, seasons, hobbies, collections, beach, zoo animals, daily routine, places, food, transport, school things, holidays mavzularidan 50 ta rasm ko‘rsatiladi, kamida 40 tasiga javob berish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Odam yoki narsa qayerdanligini “am/is/are from” shakllari orqali ayta olishi va shu…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi odam yoki narsa qayerdanligini “am/is/are from” shakllari orqali ayta olishi va shu mavzuda savol bera olishi.
normatives.example: Where are you from? I’m from Egypt. Where is she from? She’s from the UK. They’re from Brazil kabi savol-javob qilish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Narsa kimga tegishli ekanini “my”, “your”, “our”, “their” va oddiy egalik shakllari…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi narsa kimga tegishli ekanini “my”, “your”, “our”, “their” va oddiy egalik shakllari orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: This is my book. That’s their CD player. Our classroom is big. Can I use your computer? kabi gaplarni rasmga qarab aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ruxsat so‘rash, iltimos qilish va javob berishda “Can I...?”, “Can you...?”, “Yes, you…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ruxsat so‘rash, iltimos qilish va javob berishda “Can I...?”, “Can you...?”, “Yes, you can”, “No, you can’t” shakllaridan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: Can I use your computer? Can you open the door? Yes, you can. No, you can’t kabi savol-javob qilish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Sevimli mashg‘ulot, kolleksiya va bo‘sh vaqt faoliyatlari haqida “like + -ing” va oddiy…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sevimli mashg‘ulot, kolleksiya va bo‘sh vaqt faoliyatlari haqida “like + -ing” va oddiy present simple shakllarida gapira olishi.
normatives.example: I like fishing. I don’t like playing chess. Does he like reading? Yes, he does. I collect stickers kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Kundalik ishlar, vaqt va takrorlanadigan odatlar haqida present simple shaklida gapira…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kundalik ishlar, vaqt va takrorlanadigan odatlar haqida present simple shaklida gapira olishi.
normatives.example: I have breakfast at eight o’clock. Do they live in a big house? I sometimes go to the library. He never plays tennis kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Hozir bajarilayotgan harakatlarni “am/is/are + -ing” shaklida tasvirlay olishi, inkor va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi hozir bajarilayotgan harakatlarni “am/is/are + -ing” shaklida tasvirlay olishi, inkor va savol shakllarini ishlata olishi.
normatives.example: I’m swimming. She isn’t snorkelling. Is the crocodile eating? Yes, it is. What are they doing? kabi savol-javob qilish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ovqat, ichimlik, sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan narsalar haqida “a/an”, “some”, “Would you…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ovqat, ichimlik, sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan narsalar haqida “a/an”, “some”, “Would you like...?” shakllarini ishlata olishi.
normatives.example: I’d like a melon. I’d like some cereal. Would you like some bread? Yes, please. No, thanks kabi gaplarni rasmga qarab aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Joy, narsa, hayvon va odamlarni sifatlar bilan tasvirlashi, qiyosiy va orttirma…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi joy, narsa, hayvon va odamlarni sifatlar bilan tasvirlashi, qiyosiy va orttirma darajalarni qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: The red car is bigger than the blue car. Russia is bigger than the UK. The highest mountain is Mount Everest kabi gaplarni to‘ldirish va aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Qoida, majburiyat va taqiqni “must” va “mustn’t” shakllari bilan ayta olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qoida, majburiyat va taqiqni “must” va “mustn’t” shakllari bilan ayta olishi.
normatives.example: You must turn off your mobile phone. You mustn’t walk on the grass. You must listen to the teacher kabi 5 ta qoida yodlash va aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘tgan zamondagi holatlarni “was”, “wasn’t”, “were”, “weren’t”, “there was”, “there were”…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘tgan zamondagi holatlarni “was”, “wasn’t”, “were”, “weren’t”, “there was”, “there were” shakllari orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: I was at home. There was a park in our town. There were some trains. They weren’t happy kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘tgan zamonda bajarilgan ishlarni regular verbs va “did” savollari orqali ifodalay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘tgan zamonda bajarilgan ishlarni regular verbs va “did” savollari orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: They lived 5,000 years ago. They didn’t cook pizza. Did you have a good day? What did you watch last night? kabi gap va savollar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Kelajak reja va niyatlarni “be going to + verb” shaklida ayta olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kelajak reja va niyatlarni “be going to + verb” shaklida ayta olishi.
normatives.example: He’s going to play basketball tomorrow. Are you going to swim in the sea? Yes, I am. No, I’m not kabi savol-javob qilish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili

normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi consonant blends, ar, all, or, aw, oy, oi, ow, ou va oxiri o‘xshash tovushlarni o‘qib-eshtib farqlay olishi.

normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi gap tuzilishi va yozuv qoidalarini qo‘llab, sodda yozma ish tayyorlay olishi.

normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi namunaga qarab o‘zi haqida, oilasi, hobbysi, kolleksiyasi, sayohati, hayvoni, kuni yoki rejasi haqida qisqa matn yoza olishi.

normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi rasm, poster, survey chart, map, photo album yoki loyiha asosida qisqa og‘zaki taqdimot qila olishi.
normatives.example: Survey chart, poster, island map yoki photo album bo‘yicha 6 ta sodda gap tuzish : I like..., He can..., There is..., It’s bigger than..., I’m going to...shular asosida!

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Culture, extensive reading va fiction qismlaridagi mavzularni sodda inglizcha gaplar…

normatives.example: Family, animals, food, transport, school, the United Kingdom, sports events yoki clothes mavzularidan biri bo‘yicha qisqa ma'lumot berish.

normatives.name: Ingliz tili darsida ishlatiladigan ko‘rsatmalarni tushunishi, ularga amal qilishi…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ingliz tili darsida ishlatiladigan ko‘rsatmalarni tushunishi, ularga amal qilishi, eshitgan so‘z va gaplarni to‘g‘ri takrorlay olishi.
normatives.example: Listen, point, repeat, read, write, circle, tick, match, ask, answer, sing, act ko‘rsatmalarini bajaring; 6 ta gapni eshitib takrorlash.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘zi, oilasi, do‘stlari, sevimli mashg‘ulotlari, ruxsat so‘rash va kelajak rejalari…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘zi, oilasi, do‘stlari, sevimli mashg‘ulotlari, ruxsat so‘rash va kelajak rejalari haqida sodda muloqot qila olishi.
normatives.example: I like reading. Can I play games? What are you going to do this weekend? I’m going to visit my grandma kabi savol-javob qilish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Vaqtni aytishi, so‘zlarni alifbo tartibida joylashtirishi va darslikdagi asosiy so‘zlarni…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi vaqtni aytishi, so‘zlarni alifbo tartibida joylashtirishi va darslikdagi asosiy so‘zlarni taniy olishi.
normatives.example: It’s quarter past nine. It’s twenty-five to ten kabi vaqtlarni aytish; monkey, camel, zebra so‘zlarini alifbo tartibida yozish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Kitoblarda berilgan asosiy rasmli so‘zlarni eshitib taniy olishi, ko‘rsata olishi va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kitoblarda berilgan asosiy rasmli so‘zlarni eshitib taniy olishi, ko‘rsata olishi va inglizcha nomlay olishi.
normatives.example: Restaurant, food, concert, dinosaur museum, sports, directions, space, airport, TV, computers, illness, jobs, family, wildlife mavzularidan 55 ta rasm ko‘rsatiladi, kamida 44 tasini aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ovqat, restoran, xarid va miqdor haqida sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni to‘g‘ri…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ovqat, restoran, xarid va miqdor haqida sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni to‘g‘ri qo‘llab gapira olishi.
normatives.example: Can I have a bowl of pasta and some salad? Have you got any newspapers? I haven’t got much money kabi gaplarni to‘ldirish va aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Odatdagi ish va ayni paytda bo‘layotgan ishni present simple va present continuous orqali…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi odatdagi ish va ayni paytda bo‘layotgan ishni present simple va present continuous orqali farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: They usually wear blue uniforms. They’re wearing green today. He usually has pasta, but he’s eating pizza now kabi gaplarni ishlatib gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Always, usually, sometimes, rarely, never, now, today, right now, at the moment kabi vaqt…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi always, usually, sometimes, rarely, never, now, today, right now, at the moment kabi vaqt bildiruvchi so‘zlarni gapda to‘g‘ri qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Always, usually, sometimes, rarely, never, now, today, right now, at the moment so‘zlari bilan 6 ta gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘tgan zamonda bo‘lgan holat va voqealarni was, were, had, regular va irregular verbs…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lgan holat va voqealarni was, were, had, regular va irregular verbs orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: All our friends were there. The audience clapped and cheered. We didn’t go to school. Did they go to a museum?Shular asosida dialog tuzish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Narsa kimga tegishli ekanini possessive pronouns, object pronouns va oddiy egalik…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi narsa kimga tegishli ekanini possessive pronouns, object pronouns va oddiy egalik shakllari orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: Whose jacket is this? It’s mine. Give it to him. It’s hers. It’s ours. It’s theirs kabi gaplarni rasmga qarab aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Harakatning qanday bajarilganini ravishlar orqali ifodalay olishi va sodda tasviriy…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi harakatning qanday bajarilganini ravishlar orqali ifodalay olishi va sodda tasviriy gaplar tuza olishi.
normatives.example: He ran slowly. They played well. She sang beautifully. He worked hard kabi gaplarni mos rasm asosida joylashtirish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Yo‘l ko‘rsatish, ruxsat, majburiyat, sabab va maslahatni sodda inglizcha gaplar bilan…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yo‘l ko‘rsatish, ruxsat, majburiyat, sabab va maslahatni sodda inglizcha gaplar bilan ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: Go straight on. Turn left. We have to go back. Why are we here? Because we’re lost. You should drink water kabi gaplarni ishlatib gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Odam, joy, hayvon va narsalarni sifatlar bilan tasvirlashi, qiyosiy va orttirma…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi odam, joy, hayvon va narsalarni sifatlar bilan tasvirlashi, qiyosiy va orttirma darajalarni qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: My bed is more comfortable than yours. This is the most interesting book. Better, worse, the best, the worst shakllarini gapda ishlatish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Kelajakdagi taxmin, reja va niyatlarni will va be going to shakllari bilan ifodalay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kelajakdagi taxmin, reja va niyatlarni will va be going to shakllari bilan ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: People will travel in super-fast planes. Will they go back to Australia? I’m going to visit my grandma tomorrow kabi savol-javob qilish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: TV, film, kompyuter, email, internet va bo‘sh vaqt haqida maqsad, takroriylik va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi TV, film, kompyuter, email, internet va bo‘sh vaqt haqida maqsad, takroriylik va tajribani ifodalab gapira olishi.
normatives.example: I turned on the TV to watch sports. How often do you watch TV? Have you seen my speakers? I’ve never been to space kabi savol-javob qilish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Present perfect shakllarini ever, never, already o‘rganilgan holatlar doirasida savol…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi present perfect shakllarini ever, never, already o‘rganilgan holatlar doirasida savol, inkor va javoblarda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Have you ever been to space? Yes, I have. No, I haven’t. I’ve never fallen in the mountains kabi 5 ta savol-javob qilish va sodda matn tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘tmishda davom etayotgan ishni past continuous orqali aytishi va past simple bilan…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘tmishda davom etayotgan ishni past continuous orqali aytishi va past simple bilan bog‘lay olishi.
normatives.example: What were you doing? I was looking at photos. When I was working, the phone rang kabi gaplarni to‘ldirish testda va dialog tuzish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Sana, tug‘ilgan vaqt, xotira, istak va hayotiy voqealar haqida sodda gaplar bilan gapira…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi sana, tug‘ilgan vaqt, xotira, istak va hayotiy voqealar haqida sodda gaplar bilan gapira olishi.
normatives.example: My dad was born in 1971. He was born on 9th July. I wish I had a bike kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Relative pronouns, because, so, and, or, but yordamida ikki fikrni bitta tushunarli gapga…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi relative pronouns, because, so, and, or, but yordamida ikki fikrni bitta tushunarli gapga bog‘lay olishi.
normatives.example: This is the boy who helped me. This is the smoothie which was in the blender. I was tired because I played football kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Undosh birikmalar, digraphlar va murakkab tovushlarni eshitib-o‘qib farqlay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi undosh birikmalar, digraphlar va murakkab tovushlarni eshitib-o‘qib farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Bl, cl, br, cr, fl, gl, fr, gr, pl, sl, dr, tr, sm, sn, sp, sw, st, sh, ch, tch, ph, wh, th, ck, qu tovushli so‘zlarni o‘qish va guruhlash.

normatives.name: So‘z oxiri tovushlari, yumshoq tovushlar, uzun unli tovushlar, homophones va spelling…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi so‘z oxiri tovushlari, yumshoq tovushlar, uzun unli tovushlar, homophones va spelling qoidalarini o‘qish-yozishda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: King, bank, tent, camp, school, spring, square, city, giraffe, rose, train, tree, walked, visitor, hear/here, write/right so‘zlarini o‘qish, farqlash va 10 tasini yozish.

normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi matn, hikoya, maqola, she’r, xat, TV guide, leaflet, webpage yoki blogni o‘qib-tinglab, asosiy mazmun va kerakli ma’lumotni ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: Qisqa matnni o‘qing yoki tinglash ,kim, qayerda, qachon, nima qildi, nima uchun, qanday natija bo‘ldi kabi 7 ta savolga javob berish.

normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yozuv qoidalariga rioya qilib, namunaga qarab qisqa yozma ish yozishi va loyiha asosida og‘zaki taqdimot qila olishi.
normatives.example: My eating habits, my school trip, an invitation, a letter, a TV guide, a blog entry, an interview yoki story ending mavzularidan biriga 8–10 gap yozish va poster bo‘yicha 7–8 gap aytish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Ingliz tili darsidagi ko‘rsatmalarni tushunishi, topshiriqni mustaqil bajarishi va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi ingliz tili darsidagi ko‘rsatmalarni tushunishi, topshiriqni mustaqil bajarishi va eshitgan gaplarni to‘g‘ri takrorlay olishi.
normatives.example: Listen, read, repeat, match, complete, order, predict, summarize, act, discuss ko‘rsatmalarini bajarish,6 ta gapni eshitib takrorlash.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: O‘zi, oilasi, do‘stlari, qiziqishlari, kundalik ishlari va tajribasi haqida bog‘langan…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi o‘zi, oilasi, do‘stlari, qiziqishlari, kundalik ishlari va tajribasi haqida bog‘langan gaplar bilan gapira olishi.
normatives.example: My name is..., I like..., I usually..., I have never..., I have lived here for... kabi 6–8 ta gap aytish.

normatives.example: Tools, theatre, party, environment, recycling, wildlife, first aid, food, sport, history mavzularidan 60 ta so‘zdan kamida 48 tasini aytish yoki gapda ishlatish.

normatives.name: Gapdagi subject, verb, object, adjective va adverb qismlarini ajrata olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi gapdagi subject, verb, object, adjective va adverb qismlarini ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: Joe has found lots of wood. Wet paint dries slowly. kabi gaplarda subject, verb, object, adjective, adverb qismlarini belgilash.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Present simple, present continuous va past simple zamonlarini farqlab, mos vaziyatda…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi present simple, present continuous va past simple zamonlarini farqlab, mos vaziyatda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: I work every day. I’m making a robot today. I invented Chip yesterday kabi gaplarni to‘g‘ri zamonga qo‘yish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Present perfect zamonini ever, never, since va for bilan savol, javob va inkor gaplarda…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi present perfect zamonini ever, never, since va for bilan savol, javob va inkor gaplarda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Have you ever cleaned a kitchen? No, I haven’t. I’ve never made a cake. He has worked here for two weeks kabi gaplar tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Past simple va present perfect farqini already, yet, before, just so‘zlari bilan to‘g‘ri…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi past simple va present perfect farqini already, yet, before, just so‘zlari bilan to‘g‘ri ishlata olishi.
normatives.example: I visited the museum yesterday. I’ve already seen this film. I haven’t finished it yet kabi gaplarni to‘ldirish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Qiyoslash va solishtirishda comparatives, superlatives, as...as, not as...as, too va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi qiyoslash va solishtirishda comparatives, superlatives, as...as, not as...as, too va enough shakllaridan foydalana olishi.
normatives.example: This costume is as colourful as that one. It’s too dark now. There isn’t enough light kabi gaplarni tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Past simple va past continuous orqali o‘tmishdagi uzilgan yoki davom etayotgan voqealarni…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi past simple va past continuous orqali o‘tmishdagi uzilgan yoki davom etayotgan voqealarni ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: Some children were playing when we arrived. I was reading when the phone rang kabi gaplar tuzish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Oldingi odatlar va hozirgi holatni used to shakli orqali ifodalay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi oldingi odatlar va hozirgi holatni used to shakli orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: There used to be lots of litter here. I used to play in the park kabi 5 ta gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Kelajakdagi reja, taxmin va va’dalarni will, won’t, going to va present continuous future…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi kelajakdagi reja, taxmin va va’dalarni will, won’t, going to va present continuous future meaning orqali ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: He won’t make mistakes. We’re leaving at two o’clock. I’m going to adopt a tiger kabi gaplar tuzish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Reported speech orqali birov aytgan gapni sodda shaklda qayta ayta olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi reported speech orqali birov aytgan gapni sodda shaklda qayta ayta olishi.
normatives.example: She said, “I need some bandages.” → She said she needed some bandages. kabi 5 ta gapni o‘zgartirish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: First conditional orqali shart va natijani ifodalay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi first conditional orqali shart va natijani ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: If I press this button, the machine will make a pizza. Will I get ill if I don’t eat vegetables? kabi gaplar tuzish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: May, might, could, have to, had to modal shakllari bilan ehtimol, qobiliyat, majburiyat…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi may, might, could, have to, had to modal shakllari bilan ehtimol, qobiliyat, majburiyat va savolni ifodalay olishi.
normatives.example: I might need to do more work. Do you have to exercise every day? We had to tidy our bedrooms kabi gaplarni ishlatish va dialog tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Indefinite pronouns va question tags shakllarini oddiy savol-javobda qo‘llay olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi indefinite pronouns va question tags shakllarini oddiy savol-javobda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: There is something wrong. Is there anything wrong? These necklaces are beautiful, aren’t they? kabi gaplarni to‘ldirish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Present simple passive va past simple passive shakllarida gap tuza olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi present simple passive va past simple passive shakllarida gap tuza olishi.
normatives.example: English is spoken in many countries. The telephone was invented by Bell. kabi gaplarni active-passive shaklga o‘zgartirish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Mavzu bo‘yicha o‘z fikrini aytishi, sabab keltirishi va savol-javobda ishtirok eta olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi mavzu bo‘yicha o‘z fikrini aytishi, sabab keltirishi va savol-javobda ishtirok eta olishi.
normatives.example: Recycling, healthy eating, wildlife yoki school clubs mavzusida fikr aytish ,sabab keltirish va 4 ta savolga javob berish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili

normatives.example: Event poster, wildlife park map, English text messages yoki knowledge game asosida 8–10 ta gap bilan taqdimot qilish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: She’r, play script, story, information text, article, poster, report, review, forum va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi she’r, play script, story, information text, article, poster, report, review, forum va fiction matnlarini o‘qib asosiy mazmunni tushuna olishi.
normatives.example: 150–180 so‘zli matnni o‘qish; kim, qayerda, qachon, nima bo‘ldi, nima uchun kabi 8 ta savolga javob berish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Tinglangan dialog, hikoya, suhbat yoki ma’lumotli matndan kerakli tafsilotlarni ajrata…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi tinglangan dialog, hikoya, suhbat yoki ma’lumotli matndan kerakli tafsilotlarni ajrata olishi.
normatives.example: Audio yoki o‘qituvchi o‘qigan matnni tinglash; voqea tartibi, sabab, joy, odam, reja yoki natija bo‘yicha 8 ta ma’lumotni belgilash.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Yozuvda bosh harf, nuqta, savol belgisi, undov belgisi, vergul, qo‘shtirnoq va to‘g‘ri…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi yozuvda bosh harf, nuqta, savol belgisi, undov belgisi, vergul, qo‘shtirnoq va to‘g‘ri tinish belgilarini qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: 6 ta xato yozilgan gapni to‘g‘rilash; direct speech, list va question gaplarda tinish belgilarini qo‘yish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Berilgan namunaga qarab turli janrda qisqa yozma ish yoza olishi
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi berilgan namunaga qarab turli janrda qisqa yozma ish yoza olishi.
normatives.example: Poem, play script, story ending, information text, leaflet, article, newspaper report, personal account, interview, film review yoki opinion textdan birini 90–120 so‘zda yozish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: R-coloured vowels, vowel teams, schwa, silent letters va suffix tovushlarini o‘qib…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi r-coloured vowels, vowel teams, schwa, silent letters va suffix tovushlarini o‘qib, eshitib va yozib farqlay olishi.
normatives.example: Car, bird, nurse, teacher, doctor, mouse, coin, book, sauce, square, bread, deer, panda, knife, write kabi so‘zlarni o‘qish guruhlash va 12 tasini yozish .

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Murakkab letter combinations va suffixlarni so‘z ichida taniy olishi, to‘g‘ri o‘qishi va…
normatives.canDo: O‘quvchi murakkab letter combinations va suffixlarni so‘z ichida taniy olishi, to‘g‘ri o‘qishi va gapda qo‘llay olishi.
normatives.example: Picture, nature, treasure, station, television, famous, dangerous, beautiful, helpful kabi so‘zlarni o‘qish, tovushini ajratish va 6 ta gap tuzish.

normatives.subject: ingliz_tili
normatives.name: Phonics story, chant, song va game topshiriqlarida o‘rganilgan tovushlarni matn ichida…
